scope.summary: Clarify historical lane labels as audit-only policy data in the existing brand-residue catalog surface.
explicit_non_claims: No source Markdown files are added or modified.
No live baseline, signoff-door, or branch-protection context is expanded.
No new CI runner, CLI authority, or deployment surface is introduced.

facets.F1_correctness: The clarification is stored on the existing brand-residue catalog policy surface rather than Markdown prose.
facets.F2_tests: YAML, JSON, JSONL parse; generated faces regenerated; registry-drift and gate-registration are the target local gates.
facets.F3_maintainability: Historical aliases stay near the policy they describe and are explicit machine-readable data.
facets.F4_compatibility: No scanner code, workflow, or protected-check behavior changes.
facets.F5_security: No credentials or new permissions are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Prevents historical labels from being mistaken for live required checks.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path or CI fanout expansion.
facets.F9_compliance: Preserves audit traceability while keeping destination enforcement in cloud-ci/oya-ci Rust gates.
facets.F10_reversibility: The data row can be removed or amended without touching executable logic.
facets.F11_observability: Audit-chain and multispectrum evidence record the policy-data clarification.
facets.F13_migration: Supports Task #25 vocabulary cleanup without adding source Markdown.
